tsa-a17-v01.quick_english: For those standing in scriptures from Vaiṣṇava ones to southern tantras at the end, or vow-takers thereof, and even highest-scripture-standers serving unentitled lower-scripture gurus — when by the Lord's power-descent they are turned hither, then this is their rule: therein the fast-observed one on the next day — worshipped with the common mantra, his doings told — let him be led before the Lord; there, having taken his vow, let him cast it in water; then let him bathe; then having sprinkled, having purified with gruel and tooth-stick, having led him blindfolded in, by the common mantra let him have the Lord's worship performed.

tsa-a17-v02.quick_english: Then, in fire made Śiva by the common mantra, let him purify the vow; having casketed his name in his mantra, 'I purify the expiation,' ending in svāhā, let him offer a hundred times.

tsa-a17-v03.quick_english: Then too the full offering, ending in vauṣaṭ.

tsa-a17-v04.quick_english: Then, having invoked the Vow-lord, having worshipped, by Śiva's order — 'be thou his no-harm-doer' — having announced it, having satisfied him, having dismissed him, let him dismiss the fire. Thus the liṅga-lifting.

tsa-a17-v05.quick_english: Then his consecration-dwelling and the rest, as before.

tsa-a17-v01.speaker: Teacher (reclamation)
tsa-a17-v01.question: Who may be reclaimed, and how unwound?
premises: Dwellers in scriptures from Vaiṣṇava to southern tantras, or their vow-takers; even highest-scripture men serving unentitled lower gurus.

Turned hither by the Lord's power-descent: fast observed, worshipped with common mantras, doings told, led before the Lord; vow taken, cast in water; bathed, sprinkled, purified with gruel and tooth-stick, led blindfolded in, Lord worshipped by common mantra.
tsa-a17-v01.inference: Converts from any lower order are receivable on one condition: the Lord's turning-them-hither; then unwound in order — fasted, worshipped, confessed, led in, vow cast in water, bathed, purified, blindfolded, worshipped anew.

tsa-a17-v02.speaker: Teacher (fire-rite)
tsa-a17-v02.question: How is the vow purified?
premises: In Śiva-made fire by common mantra, vow purified; name casketed in own mantra.
'I purify the expiation,' ending in svāhā: a hundred offered.
tsa-a17-v02.inference: Vow-mantra dialogue in transformed fire: a hundred self-purifications ending in svāhā.

tsa-a17-v03.speaker: Teacher (full oblation)
tsa-a17-v03.question: What seals it?
premises: Then too the full offering, ending in vauṣaṭ.
tsa-a17-v03.inference: Full oblation with vauṣaṭ closes the fire-work.

tsa-a17-v04.speaker: Teacher (release)
tsa-a17-v04.question: What happens to the old bond?
premises: Vrateśvara invoked, worshipped, told by Śiva's order to be harmless.
Satisfied, dismissed; fire dismissed: thus liṅga-lifting.
tsa-a17-v04.inference: The old vow-lord is retired with honors: invoked, worshipped, ordered harmless, fed, dismissed with the fire — thus liṅga-lifting.

tsa-a17-v05.speaker: Teacher (return)
tsa-a17-v05.question: What then?
premises: Consecration-dwelling and the rest, as before.
tsa-a17-v05.inference: Adhivāsa and the rest as before: the convert rejoins the standard sequence.

tsa-a17-v06.speaker: Teacher (close)
tsa-a17-v06.question: And finally?
tsa-a17-v06.inference: Initiation at will: the convert stands where the born stood.

tsa-a17-v01.plain_english: For those standing in scriptures from the Vaiṣṇavas to the southern tantras at the end, or vow-takers thereof — and even highest-scripture-standers serving unentitled lower-scripture gurus: when they are turned hither by the Lord's descent of power, then this is their rule. Therein, let the fast-observed one on the next day — worshipped with the common mantra, his doings told — be led in before the Lord; there, having taken his vow, let him cast it in water; then let him bathe; then, having sprinkled, having purified with gruel and tooth-stick, having led him blindfolded in, by the common mantra let him have the Lord's worship performed.

tsa-a17-v02.plain_english: Then, in fire made Śiva by the common mantra, let him purify the vow; having casketed his name in his mantra, 'I purify the expiation,' ending in svāhā, let him offer a hundred times.
tsa-a17-v02.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ sādhāraṇamantreṇa śivīkṛte agnau vrataśuddhiṃ kuryāt tanmantrasampuṭaṃ nāma kṛtvā prāyaścittaṃ śodhayāmi iti svāhāntaṃ śataṃ juhuyāt

tsa-a17-v03.plain_english: Then too the full oblation, ending in vauṣaṭ.

tsa-a17-v04.plain_english: Then, having invoked the Vow-lord, having worshipped, by Śiva's order — 'be thou his no-harm-doer' — having announced it, having satisfied him, having dismissed him, let him dismiss the fire. Thus the liṅga-lifting.
tsa-a17-v04.sanskrit_cite: tato vrateśvaram āhūya pūjayitvā tasya śivājñayā akiṃcitkaraḥ tvam asya bhava iti śrāvaṇāṃ kṛtvā taṃ tarpayitvā visṛjya agniṃ visṛjet iti liṅgoddhāraḥ

essence: Converts from any lower order receivable on the Lord's turning-them-hither; unwound in order: fasted, worshipped, confessed, led in, vow cast in water, bathed, purified, blindfolded, worshipped anew.
Vow purified in Śiva-made fire: name casketed, a hundred self-purifications ending in svāhā.
Full oblation with vauṣaṭ ends the fire-work.
Old vow-lord retired with honors: invoked, worshipped, ordered harmless, fed, dismissed with fire — thus liṅga-lifting.
Adhivāsa and the rest as before: the convert rejoins the standard sequence.

rasa.justification: Six injunctions, no ornament, no hesitation: the rite stated as what is done, in order, to whom, with what words.

sections.SUMMARY: Converts from any lower order receivable on the Lord's turning-them-hither; unwound in order: fasted, worshipped, confessed, led in, vow cast in water, bathed, purified, blindfolded, worshipped anew. Vow purified in Śiva-made fire: name casketed, a hundred self-purifications ending in svāhā. Full oblation with vauṣaṭ ends the fire-work. Old vow-lord retired with honors: invoked, worshipped, ordered harmless, fed, dismissed with fire — thus liṅga-lifting. Adhivāsa and the rest as before: the convert rejoins the standard sequence. Initiation at will.
sections.FUNCTION: Unwinds the convert step by step, retires his old bond, and admits him to initiation at will.
sections.KEY TERMS: liṅgoddhāra (liṅga-lifting as reclamation); śaktipāta (descent as the only admission); sāmānya-mantra (common mantra as the beginner's vehicle); vrateśvara (old vow-lord dismissed with honors); adhivāsa (consecration-dwelling as return); yatheccham (at-will as the close).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Follows the consecration āhnika: the already-consecrated needed no rite; the convert needs unwinding first.
sections.BOUNDARY: No doctrine argued; the rite is stated, never justified.
sections.EXPLANATION: Whoever the convert was — Vaiṣṇava to southern tantra, vow-taker, even highest-scripture man under a lower guru — the Lord's turning-them-hither admits him, and this is the unwinding: fast, common worship, confession heard, led before the Lord, vow taken and drowned, bathed, sprinkled, purified with gruel and tooth-stick, led blindfolded in, Lord worshipped by common mantra. Then the vow is purified in Śiva-made fire: name casketed in mantra, a hundred self-purifications ending in svāhā, then the full offering with vauṣaṭ. Then the old bond is honorably retired: Vrateśvara invoked, worshipped, told by Śiva's order to be harmless, fed, dismissed — and the fire with him. That is liṅgoddhāra. Adhivāsa and the rest follow as before. Initiation — at will.
sections.RELATED: Vishvasa ch.17 translation (full English, same text); Wallis śaktipāta (turning as admission criterion); no external translation witness — qa NEEDS_WITNESS expected.

vow taken, cast in water; bathed, sprinkled, gruel-and-toothstick-purified,
blindfold led in, by common mantra let the Lord be worshipped.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: who-may-be-reclaimed (FIRST-VERSE of the batch: plain injunctive catalogue; sets the workmanlike voice — owner verdict required before treating as house voice). Sanskrit: vaiṣṇavādi...unmukhīkriyante → L4 keeps who-list then rule. Rows: row 3 (turned→rule). Close: worshipped (pūjā as landing). Rejected: smoothing the catalogue — kept whole (the list IS the verse); 'convert' — kept turned-hither (unmukhī as facing-toward).

reads_against.argmap: Who may be reclaimed, and how unwound? → Converts from any lower order are receivable on one condition: the Lord's turning-them-hither; then unwound in order — fasted, worshipped, confessed, led in, vow cast in water, bathed, purified, blindfolded, worshipped anew.
c1_essence: Converts from any lower order receivable on the Lord's turning-them-hither; unwound in order: fasted, worshipped, confessed, led in, vow cast in water, bathed, purified, blindfolded, worshipped anew.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: vow-purified (hundredfold). Rows: row 2 (sealed→poured). Close: poured (homa as landing). Rejected: 'atonement' — kept penance (prāyaścitta precise); 'sacred fire' gloss — kept fire-turned-Śiva (the transformation IS the rite).

reads_against.argmap: How is the vow purified? → Vow-mantra dialogue in transformed fire: a hundred self-purifications ending in svāhā.
c1_essence: Vow purified in Śiva-made fire: name casketed, a hundred self-purifications ending in svāhā.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: full-seal (single-line close of fire-work). Rows: row 1 (whole — never split the seal). Close: sealed (vauṣaṭ as landing). Rejected: expanding to couplet — kept single (form follows Sanskrit brevity).

reads_against.argmap: What seals it? → Full oblation with vauṣaṭ closes the fire-work.
c1_essence: Full oblation with vauṣaṭ ends the fire-work.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: old-bond-retired (invoke-feed-dismiss). Rows: row 2 (told→dismiss). Close: lifting (liṅgoddhāra as landing: the named rite closes). Rejected: 'absolution' — killed: kept no-harm (akiṃcitkara as the exact order); 'gods' plural — kept fire dismissed (agni singular).

reads_against.argmap: What happens to the old bond? → The old vow-lord is retired with honors: invoked, worshipped, ordered harmless, fed, dismissed with the fire — thus liṅga-lifting.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: as-before (return to sequence). Rows: row 1 (whole). Close: before (prāgvat as landing: backward-looking close). Rejected: explaining adhivāsa — kept dwelling-over (the term, unglossed in song).

reads_against.argmap: What then? → Adhivāsa and the rest as before: the convert rejoins the standard sequence.
